:::{#rem-transpose-column-to-row}
#### Transposing a column vector

The transpose turns a column vector into a row vector
with the same entries in the same order.
For example,

$$
\tp{\begin{bmatrix} 2 \\ -1 \\ 5 \end{bmatrix}}
= [2,\; -1,\; 5].
$$

For a matrix, the transpose swaps the rows and the columns
(@def-matrix-transpose).

:::
